_comment: 阶段 B 的判断文件模板。复制到 /app/work/agent_judgement.json 后按实际材料填写。
quote 必须是材料里的逐字片段 —— 脚本会逐条校验，找不到就退回。
case_id 必须与 /input/case.json 里的 case_id 一致。
本题示例为合成材料，不是正式案例结果。

claims.text: PC-A retained 92 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles at 1 A/g.

evidence.quote: the PC-A electrode retained 92 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles

claims.text: The activated carbon baseline retained 78 % under the same conditions.

evidence.quote: the activated carbon baseline retained only 78 % under the same conditions

claims.text: PC-B retained 85 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles at 2 A/g in an organic electrolyte.

evidence.quote: PC-B retained 85 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles

answers.question: What retention values and conditions are reported?
answers.answer: PC-A: 92 % after 5000 cycles at 1 A/g; activated carbon baseline: 78 % under the same conditions; PC-B: 85 % after 5000 cycles at 2 A/g in an organic electrolyte.

evidence.quote: the PC-A electrode retained 92 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles
PC-B retained 85 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles

deliverable: Five assertions: A1 PC-A 92 % at 1 A/g; A2 baseline 78 % under the same conditions; A3 PC-A exceeds baseline (inferred from A1+A2); A4 PC-B 85 % at 2 A/g in organic electrolyte; A5 the paper suggests the resorcinol-derived pore structure is more stable (inferred). Conditions are attached to each assertion and inference is marked separately.

assertions.text: PC-A retained 92 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles at 1 A/g.
assertions.subject: PC-A

evidence.quote: the PC-A electrode retained 92 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles

assertions.text: The activated carbon baseline retained 78 % under the same conditions.
assertions.subject: activated carbon baseline

evidence.quote: the activated carbon baseline retained only 78 % under the same conditions

assertions.text: PC-A retained more capacitance than the activated carbon baseline under the same conditions.
assertions.subject: PC-A

evidence.quote: the PC-A electrode retained 92 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles
the activated carbon baseline retained only 78 % under the same conditions

assertions.text: PC-B retained 85 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles at 2 A/g in an organic electrolyte.
assertions.subject: PC-B

evidence.quote: PC-B retained 85 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles

assertions.text: The resorcinol-derived pore structure of PC-A is more stable than the activated carbon baseline.
assertions.subject: resorcinol-derived pore structure

evidence.quote: The higher retention of PC-A suggests that the resorcinol-derived pore structure is more stable than the activated carbon baseline.

source_metadata.title: Cycling stability of porous carbon electrodes
source_metadata.note: Synthetic metadata for offline demonstration only.

quality_checks.basis: single subject/predicate/object with explicit current density and cycle count.
marked inferred; comparison derived from A1 and A2 under the same conditions.
author interpretation ('suggests') is recorded as inferred, not as a measured fact.
current density, cycle count and electrolyte are attached.

uncertainties.detail: The material does not state which electrolyte was used in the 1 A/g test.
uncertainties.resolution: Recorded only the reported conditions; did not infer the electrolyte.

uncertainties.detail: A3 is a comparison derived from two reported values; A5 is the authors' interpretation.
uncertainties.resolution: Marked both as inferred and kept them separate from direct reported assertions.
